title: aaj naayeb sayyade sajjad ka paida hua
body:
aaj naayeb sayyade sajjad ka paida hua
hazrate baaqar shahe har dosara paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
quld me hai shaad behad ahmade muqtaar aaj
paanchwa masnad nasheene mustafa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
de rahe hai tehniyat sab hazrate shabbir ko
aaj pota chaand sa shabbir ka paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar pote ki surat shaad hai behad hussain
kehte hai salle alaa kya mailaqa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab o kulsoom qush hai shaad hai abbas bhi
aaj fazle haq se pota chand sa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr se is shaahe dee'n ke ban gaya umamt ka kaam
nasire dee'n fidya e raahe quda paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad hai hur o malak masroor hai sab inso jin
haadiye dee'n shaafiye roze jaza paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hazireene jashn ka bar aaye ya rab mud'duaa
sadqa is moulood ka jo mailaqa paida hua
